Ask every time

These controls apply only to this Collie installation. They do not prevent someone from adding your account on the service or change what your linked devices do.
Groups held for review stay held when you change this setting. Open the group to review it. Invitations that already require Accept still need your approval, even from someone you choose.
Contacts access is off. Collie cannot verify who is saved on this device, so new additions will need your review. You can allow contacts access in Android’s app permissions.
If Collie cannot identify who added you, the group needs your review. Choosing someone never overrides blocking.
